scope: All 38frames including 6workspace overviews and all 24drawn edges assessed against finite selected offline prototype. Representation is not production enforcement or every possible interleaving.

frames.evidence: Case list with search, empty/error recovery, owner, next step and status filters; team desktop/mobile rendered.
Summary, addressed immutable requests, correlated responses, initial Sources, task/physical-state separation; evidence inspected.
Requested, queued, owned, awaiting answer and resolved operator states; filters and due time visible.
Current revision/stage, required rationale/review, rejection, clarification answer and bounded continuation exercised.
Selected delivery, quote, approved return, investigation and refusal flows exercised with scoped consent and recovery.
Configure, local rehearsal failure/pass, enable, registered run and editing a new draft without changing active run exercised.
Case open and search/filters; real owner and next-step labels. Local load failure has retry rather than empty-list success.
001 invitation draft, edit/source boundaries, send acknowledgement and pre-send permission denial; denied quote retains original kind.
001 second slot preserved on team/customer result, with current-run confirmation and physical delivery pending.
Invitation acknowledgement before customer choice; owner/next check/deadline/budget/fallback in team UI.
Slot required, date/time/price visible, alternative date and help retained; back focus returns to slot.
Exact chosen object/time/price consent stored before booking; changes invalidate selection/consent.
Exact confirmed chosen result; close and reopen operate locally without creating another command.
Sending/wait/UNKNOWN distinct; interruption preserved and same-intent recovery remains bounded.
Explicit refusal, optional reason, cancel; interruption and late response after stop reach refusal_saved.
Saved refusal separate from collection. Already-authorized SIM permits terms; unknown authority blocks collection and retains owner.
Scenario-relative date limits, required address/agreement; exact object/date/time/address/price/revision consent saved.
Collection confirmation and reference separate from physical receipt; exact agreed address/date retained.033 reuses source consent.
Help acknowledgement/ownership, reason, time, due time, saved stage, filters and customer answer retained.
Version and stage captured, required note/review confirmation; owner decides clarification/continue/stop without booking.
Visible case-version change causes rejected decision; form retained; current facts must be reviewed again.
Clarify→customer answer→queue→explicit one-search allowance→usable form, without resetting command/check budget or fabricating consent.
Unknown waits retain original kind/ID; wrong/stale evidence rejected, acknowledgement not outcome, bounded checks escalate.
Explicit no-new-action consequences; native dialog, Escape and invoking-control return.
Stop remains set; late confirmed effect visible; no collection after stopped refusal. No rollback claim.
Requested acknowledgement visibly separate; simulated acknowledgement failure remains blocked; verification recovers registration.
Snapshot hash, workflow/simulator version, virtual clock, finite limits and permission configured; enable disabled until checks.
Injected incorrect outcome gives expected/actual trace, failed status and disabled enable; correction/recheck reachable.
Registered unique run with frozen launched config; editing next draft leaves active run and limits unchanged.
Metadata and bounded shared-transition rehearsal pass; explicit enable before run registration, with launching state.
Current requested date/object/full surcharge preserved in outgoing body; dispatch recipient and permitted channel retained.
Acknowledgement distinct from valid quote; current pending owner/deadline/check budget/fallback visible.
New reply provides GBP8/10 options; second selection reviewed and confirmed; changed offer changes actual times/prices.
Customer-safe next update/status and current-booking caveat; internal team budget/contact omitted.
031RT/TG/DL source link and existing approval; no repeated refusal; request addressed to label team.
Pending label separated from receipt; stale/wrong evidence rejects through shared response route.
Mock label opens with IDs and not-valid-for-shipping warning; link-expiry/read recovery creates no new business request.
Existing return approval retained, unavailable label remains pending; customer can return and request help.
